_about: Curated main airline of each of the 100 Major hubs (the Daily top 50 plus ranks 51-100). Read by scripts/hint_data.py at build time; the app never fetches Wikipedia or Wikidata. 'dominant' true -> hint 'Main airline: X', false -> 'A main airline here: X'; confidence 'low' -> no airline hint, the region / position chain is used. Every entry has a source URL. Evidence was fetched with scripts/hub_evidence.py. 'support' says which sources name the airline for this airport.
